source: Likewise, NF4 is not simply “ZXNAME0000XZ with a different scale.” It is a 4-bit codebook designed around a normalized normal-weight assumption in QLoRA. Current bitsandbytes code explicitly treats NF4 as a lookup codebook rather than a sign/exponent/mantissa float format.
zh: 同样，NF4 也不仅仅是“不同规模的 ZXNAME0000XZ”。它是一个 4 位码本，围绕 QLoRA 中的标准化正常权重假设而设计。当前的 bitsandbytes 代码明确将 NF4 视为查找码本，而不是符号/指数/尾数浮点格式。
